messages:
Priya Reddy: quick heads-up  we need to schedule the post-incident review for INC-2026-04 (gateway 5xx spike). looking for a facilitator and confirmation of attendees. i'd like to keep this to 40m and be pragmatic about action items. incident-bot posted the automated summary below. pls shout if you can't make the week.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident INC-2026-04 detected 2009873000. Severity: P2. Symptom: transient 5xx burst on inference-gateway affecting select customers for ~18m. Mitigations: service rollback + partial traffic diversion. Pager: @Nora Chen.

Priya Reddy: Facilitation options: Diego Alvarez (pref), Nora Chen (backup), or we can pull from the facilitator-rotation pool. Also considering a shorter async review if too many conflicts. Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 08:30-09:10 (short morning slot)
- Thu 13:00-13:40 (lunch slot)
React with :white_check_mark: on the slot you can attend; add 'facilitate: yes' if you can run it. Please call out mandatory attendees (SRE/runtime/support/legal if customer escalation).

Diego Alvarez: facilitate: yes for Thu 13. I can run through timeline + mitigation reasoning. I'll try to keep it tight and assign action owners in the meeting.

Nora Chen: backup: yes. I'll be there too (pager during event). Can present the oncall transcript and the steps we executed.

Samir Kapoor: SRE here. Thu 13 works best; morning's tough due to infra window. i'll bring log pointers and sampling notes.

Lina Brooks: support/customer ops. I'll present customer impact. one customer asked for a named contact and wants a postmortem; may need legal cc depending on wording. Thu 13 preferred.

Priya Reddy: OK Thu 13 it is then with Diego as facilitator. Draft agenda (40m):
1) 3-min TL;DR for execs (who needs a one-liner)
2) timeline & what happened (10m)
3) what we tried and why (10m)
4) evidence + hypotheses (10m)
5) clear action items + owners (5m)
We need to decide the communication plan for the customer who requested a PM. Lina, can you flag legal if wording is sensitive?

Lina Brooks: will flag legal if they request contractual language. otherwise i'll draft a neutral timeline and next-steps paragraph.

Diego Alvarez: I'll draft a two-slide handout (exec one-pager + detailed timeline) and drop in Confluence before the meeting. Also will run the meeting notes live.

Nora Chen: Commands we executed during mitigation (will paste into artifacts):
```
# quick rollback to last known-good
redwood deploy rollback --service=inference-gateway --to=stable-2026-06-11
# route 30% traffic to fallback region
redwood router set-weight --service=inference-gateway --region=fallback --weight=30
```
I'll attach the oncall transcript and Alertmanager dump. note: trace sampling was low in that window so some spans are missing.

Samir Kapoor: SRE note: we saw a spike coinciding with a batching config flip and a kernel selection path change. i'll surface the config diffs and estimated rollback cost (ops-hours) in the remediation section. also proposing a short-term synthetic check on the main inference path.

Priya Reddy: Links: calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event?eid=pm-2009876543-thu13 and confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/INC-2026-04-2009876543 (please add artifacts to the page). if logs are >5MB upload to artifacts and paste link.

Diego Alvarez: RSVP yes. i'll upload the slides to artifacts and the confluence page before the meeting.

Lina Brooks: RSVP yes (may be ~5m late). uploaded sanitized ticket excerpts: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/tickets/INC-2026-04/tickets-sanitized.zip

Nora Chen: RSVP yes. uploaded oncall transcript + alert exports: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/oncall/INC-2026-04/transcript.log

Samir Kapoor: RSVP yes. uploaded SRE log bundle and a short proposal for an additional synthetic check: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/sre/inc-2026-04/sre-notes.pdf

Priya Reddy: Pre-meeting asks:
- Diego: prepare the two-slide handout + take notes
- Nora: paste runbook excerpt + exact CLI history
- Samir: remediation estimates + validation plan
- Lina: customer impact summary + suggested comms text
I'll consolidate action items to the Confluence table with columns: action, owner, due, ETA, verification, customer-facing?

incident-bot: [AUTO] Reminder scheduled: INC-2026-04 post-incident review Thu 13:00 PT (2009879100).

Diego Alvarez: Uploaded draft slides and initial timeline to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/INC-2026-04-2009876543#slides

Nora Chen: Added runbook excerpt and the exact toggle history. note: a toggle to enable a new batching optimizer landed 3 days prior. may be related.

Samir Kapoor: Added remediation tracker stub and rough effort (ops hrs). will refine during the meeting.

Lina Brooks: Added customer comms draft. flagged one account for legal review if they ask for liability language.

Priya Reddy: If anyone can't make it, add a proxy note on the Confluence page. we'll capture owners during the meeting and publish a short postmortem within 48 hours. after the meeting i'll re-open this thread for tracking the action items. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
